summary: Listed in the Georgia lookout-tower list for Treutlen County with two register codes; no source found on its history or present state.

evidence.supports: Lookout is listed under the name soperton in Treutlen County, with register codes BLL-64717 and gfc-510.

notes_for_editor: Only source is the tnlandforms Georgia list, which carries the codes BLL-64717 and gfc-510 without explaining them, so they are recorded only as listed, not as facts. The bare number 344 has no unit; the record's elevation_m 104.8 assumes feet; verify. Searches and reads of the Wikipedia article on Soperton, Georgia found no tower history. One web-search snippet (unverified, a telecom registry aggregator) described a 38 m structure registered to the State of Georgia in Soperton with unknown status; it is not tied to a lookout, so it is not used. Worth checking whether that is the old GFC site. No story written: the evidence is one list entry, below the 120-word floor. Next steps: Georgia Forestry Commission records for tower 510, Treutlen County historical society, historic USGS topographic maps.
